_about: Registry of this style's components (SYSTEM.md): what each one is, its kind and the regexes (sig) that find it in a built index.html. scripts/components.py plan / check / add / record read and write it: history lists your reels in order, projects maps a reel id to its project folder, and each element's reels say where it was used. Empty history = nothing used yet.
_about_components: kind = hook / scene / prop / frame / transition / outro (new every reel) or emphasis / signature / house (may stay); sig = regexes (a LIST) on the built index.html; history = reels in order; projects = where each reel's index.html is. scripts/components.py reads and writes this file. The proof reels are recorded only after the OK.

elements.desc: one centred caption line; every word pops on in one frame at its spoken start at its final place (Inter 500 62 px, white; ink over light grounds)
one heavy word per phrase (two short ones share the line): Oswald 700 caps up to 168 px under the small words
quotes, coined terms, names: Playfair Display italic (captions, picture labels, polaroid labels)
the turn line alone on the baked grey page, a black block the size of each word 3 frames ahead
a picture as a print on its own blurred, darkened copy (B&W), slow push
every picture black and white; one red #D63A2F for the payoff word, label boxes, counters, strikes
scene changes are hard cuts on phrase starts; no dissolves, flashes, glitches, no fade at the end
flat bed ~19 dB under the voice; SFX only under picture events; the payoff without SFX (quiet())
format A: the plate (as shot) pushes in x1.05 over the first 1.1 s while the first words pop on
the one montage burst: full-bleed B&W pictures cut on the listed words in the hook (B: files, a clock, a telephone)
the speaker's own night clip as a print, pushing in from frame 0 (C: the skyline through the living-room window)
a quote typed on warm paper word by word as spoken, mono, caret at the end (C: Simmel)
a coined term on warm paper in the serif italic with the cursor (B: …)
white caps with a soft glow on black, a word snapping on per beat (not used yet)
polaroids on the grey page, one per word, the camera sliding to the newest
a picture in a window on black stepping up in three sizes, then a slow push
an archive portrait as a print with the person's name in the serif on a dark band
a number counting up in red Playfair 900, a tick per value, its unit under it (B: 38 000 …)
a red box wiping on with the stressed words in Oswald caps + a white sub-line strip
the big word loses its letters right to left on a word meaning 'disappears' (A: …«…»)
the picture changes state in one frame on its word (B: the switch flips on «…»)
a red line drawn through the picture on the word it rejects (B: the sofa on «…»)
a 2-frame punch-in on a picture on the stressed word
a punch-in on the face that acts out the word (A: «…» comes too close)
the payoff returns to the hook's picture (B: the deck chair)
the payoff on a door opening onto light (C)
the payoff held on the face with the last big words in red (A: …)
railway split-flap board above the head: the hook number in black tiles (red digits) + a rail sub-line, legible on frame 0; tiles flip by squash (old char out, new char in) for status changes
an open book on the grey page (author running head, title in serif, grey text bars); a red pencil bracket draws in the margin beside one passage on its word, the passage inks in
a vintage double-oval wedding portrait on a cabinet-card mount: an archive man on the left, the phone as the partner on the right (lands on its word), a red serif ampersand in the held pause
a vertical film contact sheet (sprockets, frame numbers) of three B&W frames for a spoken list; a red grease-pencil circle draws around each frame on its word
an engraved balance scale on the grey page: the fear weight (a serif tag quoting the words) holds the left pan down until a red weight drops into the right pan on the word and tips the beam
bookend: the hook split-flap board returns over the payoff and its tiles flip to blank one by one on the free-time word, held to a hard end on the face
a telegram form pasted above the head from frame 0: two PT Mono tape strips carry the hook text, the key phrase red
slot-machine drum in the chest band: spins on the verb, stops on each listed word (Oswald caps) as it is said
term page on warm paper: serif small word + big Oswald word, a drawn plug pulls out of its wall socket on the word
a paper receipt prints up in the chest band, PT Mono rows land on their words: header, the number in red, the findings
full-screen 2x2 grid of B&W object pictures on black, one tile cuts in per listed word, holds as a set
the hook telegram returns in the payoff: its first strip struck in red, a reply strip with the payoff words lands; flat end

frame 0: the text hook split around the face, line 1 above the head (small words + one big Oswald word on the red box), line 2 under the chin (small + big), static and readable on frame 0, clears on the next phrase
a real B&W print (book cover) taped in the side column beside the face (not full screen), slow push, the author name typed on its margin on the name word
listed sources stack in Oswald in the chest band, each on its word; a red rubber stamp «…» slams beside each (2 frames, one thud each)
a numbered list builds in the chest band: white Playfair numerals on red squares, Oswald items, every word on its spoken start, a small Inter sub-line under the last item; silent
the last line is set in the frame-0 hook type (small lines + the big word on the red box, no question mark), word by word on the voice, held to a hard end: frame 0 asks, the last frame answers
frame-1 hook text on a warm-paper museum caption card pinned above the head, the key word underlined red
a print held by four album photo corners (one red) that snap on at the cut
an old page as a print, a round loupe slides in and magnifies the text on the detail word
a thin ink timeline draws above the head: a pin for the past date, a red dot for now
the hook's caption card returns on the thanks line and a red tick draws beside its key word; payoff clean after
frame 0: the hook line on a warm-paper strip in the empty band above the head (the cabinet), held through line 1 while captions land below
a listed attempt lands as a second print dropped on top of the first (tilted, hard), a pile of tried methods
turn page starts dimmed; the light switches on (hard, click) on the idea word, which lands red
five outline stars under the CTA caption fill red one by one on the word review
payoff held on the face, the delete word as a red box, no SFX, hard end
